verbatim_excerpt:
34-24 Modification of Height and Setback Regulations

C1 C2 C3 C4 C5 C6

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations set forth in Article II, Chapter 3, and made applicable to such districts in Section 34-11 (General Provisions), are modified as set forth in this Section.

(a) In Commercial Districts with R1 through R5 equivalency

In #Commercial Districts# mapped within, or with a #residential equivalent# of an R1 through R5 District, the modifications to #residential# height and setback regulations set forth in Section 35-62 shall be applied.

(b) In Commercial Districts with R6 through R12 equivalency

In #Commercial Districts# mapped within, or with a #residential equivalent# of R6 through R12 Districts:

(1) the modifications to #residential# height and setback regulations set forth in Section 35-63, inclusive, shall be applied;

(2) the special height and setback provisions for certain areas set forth in Section 36-64 shall be applied; and

(3) where the optional #bulk# regulations for #sky exposure plane buildings# are utilized, the provisions set forth in Section 35-71, inclusive, shall be applied. Where any of such optional provisions are utilized, all the other associated #bulk# provisions shall apply.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks joined by a blank line, in page order: [0] the displayed section number and title; then each body paragraph and list item. A list item is written with the label the section's print/PDF render prints in front of it, followed by one space; a list item's heading line and its following text (a double line break in the HTML) are separate blocks, and only the heading (the first block of the item) carries the label. Defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures are omitted; no word was changed. The list-item labels were confirmed against the print/PDF render (cross_check: match).
notes: Captured as source text only for the R6B commercial-overlay checks (work-order step P2, gap K9; task M4-T026, D-090 R291). The capture holds the official section text and its provenance; it encodes no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, and no number derived from it.

Channel: the authoritative, pinned channel is the canonical section HTML (raw_html_sha256 and response_bytes in source). The section's print/PDF render was fetched once and used ONLY as a text check; its body matched the HTML excerpt word-for-word (cross_check.result = match). Per M4-T025 finding F4 (DB-167) the PDF bytes are regenerated per request and are NOT pinned.

List-item labels in the excerpt ((a), (b), (1), (2), (3)) are the labels the section's own print/PDF prints in front of each item. The HTML renders these as CSS ordered-list markers with no label glyph in the page text, so the labels are taken from the print/PDF text (not from the HTML and not from the helper lead). This is the M4-T025 finding-F1 practice applied: where a label is not printed in the HTML text, it is taken from the print/PDF and that is stated.
Sections and defined terms this text points to are listed, with their pointing words and whether the repository already holds a capture, in the M4-T026 producer report; none is captured by this task.
